title: High lunge
steps: From a low lunge, tuck your back toes and lift the back knee off the mat.
Keep the front knee above the ankle and press through the back foot.
Reach both arms up and lengthen through the whole body.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower the back knee and change sides.
mistakes: Letting the front knee drift past the toes.
Arching the lower back to reach higher.
